meta.key_definition: da_shrubs.cpp read_part_keys / kind_of, reproduced by tools/trees/census_trees.py: part key = FNV-1a 64 of the lower-case shader string, its zero, the u32 triangle count of the full-detail window and the wrapping sum of the triangles' hashes (vertices as mm positions and uv mod 2048, sorted per triangle); kind key = FNV-1a 64 over the sorted part keys (u64 LE)
meta.skeleton_rule: the wood parts (flora\trunk_wave: bark and cut ends): one part's key, several hashed like a kind key; no wood or a young tree: p<kind key>
meta.signature_rule: [shrub_families] format: FNV-1a 64 over the parts sorted by shader (lower-case string + zero + u32 triangles); rows <member key>:<box mm min xyz>:<box mm max xyz>:<area m2>
